
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/halfcode/p/22321282" title="发布于 2026-08-08 07:08">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">7. 打开App再截图：启停3步闭环</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>配套动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1jcg96BE35/" rel="noopener nofollow">《7. Langchain 打开App再截图：启停3步闭环》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1jcg96BE35/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》。</a></p>
<p>上一节能截当前屏幕了，但自动化里更常见的是：先打开目标 App，再截首屏，最后把应用关掉。这一节就把「启动 → 截图 → 关闭」收成一条闭环。</p>
<p>整体流程是这样的：先把 .env 里的 HDC_PATH 注入 PATH，再读设备配置和应用包名；然后连接真机、打开应用，等首屏出来并截图。文件为空也算失败，但无论成败都要关掉应用；成功则保存到 screenshots。</p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1919157/202608/1919157-20260807212105474-850538655.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;先说文件顶部。Hypium 的 connect_device 只认系统 PATH 里的 hdc，不会读 HDC_PATH。所以在 import 之后先调用 load_dotenv() 读入 .env，再把其中的 HDC_PATH（toolchains 目录）写进 PATH。后面连真机、截图才能找到 hdc：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> dotenv <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> load_dotenv
load_dotenv()
hdc </span>= os.getenv(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">HDC_PATH</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> hdc <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">and</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path(hdc).exists():
    os.environ[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PATH</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>] = hdc + os.pathsep + os.environ.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PATH</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">''</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>连真机交给 _setup_driver：从 device_config.json 读取设备信息，用 connect_device 连上真机，再包装成 UiDriver。没传 sn 时默认用配置里第 1 台设备。没有 driver，后面的 start_app / stop_app 都调不了：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> _setup_driver(device_sn=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">None):
    config_path </span>= os.path.join(..., <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">config</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">device_config.json</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    with open(config_path, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, encoding=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">utf-8</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) as f:
        config_data </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> json.load(f)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> device_sn:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> config_data.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">devices</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">):
            device_sn </span>= config_data[<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">devices</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>][0][<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sn</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> device_sn:
        device </span>= connect_device(device_sn=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">device_sn)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        device </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> connect_device()
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> UiDriver(device)</pre>
</div>
<p>闭环入口是 open_app_screenshot_close。一进来先从配置里取出要启动的应用：bundle_name、ability_name；再确定截图保存路径，默认是 testcases/screenshots/app_screenshot.png：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">def</span> open_app_screenshot_close(screenshot_path: str =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None):
    target </span>= config.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">target_app</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, {})
    bundle_name </span>= target.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bundle_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">com.example.myapp</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    ability_name </span>= target.get(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ability_name</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EntryAbility</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">not</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> screenshot_path:
        screenshot_path </span>= os.path.join(base_dir, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testcases</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">screenshots</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">app_screenshot.png</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>接着用 _setup_driver 拿到 driver，再 start_app 把应用拉到前台，sleep(3) 等首屏渲染完。这样后面截到的才是 App 界面，而不是桌面：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>driver =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _setup_driver()
result_path </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> None
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    driver.start_app(bundle_name, ability_name)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[启动] 应用已启动：{bundle_name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    time.sleep(</span>3)</pre>
</div>
<p>截图直接调用已有的 _do_take_screenshot，不要重写截图逻辑。成功返回文件路径，失败（含空文件）返回 None：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>result_path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _do_take_screenshot(screenshot_path)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> result_path:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[截图] 成功：{result_path}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[截图] 失败</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)</pre>
</div>
<p>stop_app 必须放在 finally 里：截图成功要关，失败也要关，避免应用留在前台。关掉后再短等 1 秒，最后 return result_path：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">finally</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">:
        driver.stop_app(bundle_name)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[关闭] 应用已关闭：{bundle_name}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        time.sleep(</span>1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">except</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception as e:
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">print</span>(f<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[关闭] 应用关闭失败：{e}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> result_path</pre>
</div>
<p>配套动画视频在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1jcg96BE35/" rel="noopener nofollow">《7. Langchain 打开App再截图：启停3步闭环》</a>，源代码在<a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1jcg96BE35/" rel="noopener nofollow">《评论区置顶》。</a></p>
<p>跑通这条闭环后，Agent 就能按「开 App → 截屏 → 关 App」稳定拿到界面截图，也为后面出报告准备好素材。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
